title: Maria Luisa Park and Plaza de España
text: We visited the Maria Luisa Park and Plaza de España, as the day before we were cancelled the Tour of Seville Heritage: Las Setas, La Macarena and the Dueñas Palace. Well, it's true that we were refunded the difference. The visit with Carmen, alias Brunilda 😂, was great, we got to know the ins and outs of the Maria Luisa park and its romantic history, as well as seeing the Spanish Steps and some of the pavilions of the 1929 Ibero-American Exposition. Good guide, we had a good time with her. It is recommended, for understanding the comics of the park and square that are in popular culture of Sev
